cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Dog ≠ cat – a common domestic animal kept as a pet.

p.em: Example: He feeds his dog every morning.

cosy-blockquote.p: Cat ≠ dog – a small domesticated carnivorous mammal.

p.em: Example: My cat sleeps on the sunny sofa.

cosy-blockquote.p: Pet ≠ wild animal – an animal kept for companionship.

p.em: Example: Dogs and cats are popular house pets.

cosy-blockquote.p: Home ≠ street – the place where one lives permanently.

p.em: Example: Every homeless animal deserves a warm home.

cosy-blockquote.p: Feed ≠ starve – to give food to an animal or person.

p.em: Example: Volunteers feed stray cats in the park.

cosy-blockquote.p: Adopt ≠ buy – to take an animal into your home as a pet.

p.em: Example: We decided to adopt a puppy from the shelter.

cosy-blockquote.p: Care ≠ neglect – the process of keeping someone or something safe and healthy.

p.em: Example: Pets need love, water, and daily care.

cosy-blockquote.p: Shelter ≠ street – a place that gives protection to homeless animals.

p.em: Example: The animal shelter has thirty dogs.

cosy-blockquote.p: Kind ≠ cruel – friendly, generous, and considerate.

p.em: Example: Be kind to street animals in winter.

cosy-blockquote.p: Water ≠ milk – a clear liquid essential for all living animals.

p.em: Example: Always leave clean water for stray dogs.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
Do you have a pet dog or cat at home?
★ What was the name of your first pet?

Why is it important to adopt homeless animals from shelters?
★ Have you ever visited an animal shelter?

How can people show care for stray street animals in summer?
★ Do you put out fresh water for birds or cats?

What food do you feed to outdoor birds or stray pets?
★ Do you keep animal treats in your bag?

Why is a loving home essential for every rescued pet?
★ How do pets make a home feel cozy?

Is an independent cat easier to look after than an active dog?
★ Are you a cat person or a dog person?

How does a community animal shelter help stray animals?
★ Have you ever donated to an animal rescue charity?

Why is it important to be kind to all living creatures?
★ Who taught you to respect animals?

Why do street animals need clean drinking water in hot weather?
★ Have you seen water bowls outside local shops?

What responsibilities come with owning a house pet?
★ What advice would you give to a new pet owner?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: collaborative task or visual analysis in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, work together on the following task:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: 1-on-1 guided visual description and task response with teacher.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Look at the prompt and discuss your response with your teacher:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
People should always adopt pets from shelters instead of buying from breeders. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you adopt a rescue animal?

Cities should provide free food and medical care for stray street animals. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Are there many stray animals in your town?

Taking good care of a pet teaches children empathy and discipline. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Did you look after a pet when you were young?

Every neighborhood animal shelter should receive state funding. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How can volunteers help local shelters?

Leaving fresh water outside for homeless animals should be a civic habit. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you put water outside during heatwaves?

It is better to feed stray animals regularly than to ignore them. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Have you ever fed a stray cat or dog?

A domestic dog requires more daily exercise and attention than a cat. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you like daily dog walks?

Being kind to animals reflects the moral strength of a society. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ What animal rights issues matter to you?

Every apartment building should welcome family pet owners. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Are apartments in your city pet-friendly?

Finding a safe home for every stray pet is an achievable global goal. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How can technology help animal adoption?

ul.li: Incorrect: We can to help street dogs. → Correct: We can help street dogs. ((Modal verb 'can' is followed by base verb without 'to'.))
Incorrect: The cat have hunger. → Correct: The cat is hungry / has food. ((Describe state with 'is hungry', or use 3rd person singular 'has'.))
